evidence.quote: Genesis is a family run, independent cinema and arts venue

findings.value: Mostly film screenings, many with a Q&A or intro. Also a recurring Bar Trash season of genre double bills, and occasional live wrestling nights (not music). Music is not a main part of the listings we read.

evidence.quote: BAR TRASH continues our 14th sensational season

findings.value: Standard prices depend on the day of the week; event tickets can be priced differently.

not_found: music.styles: no music genres named on the listings or the about page
live music nights: none seen in the listings read; the hire page mentions live music only as a possible private hire
notes: Nights seen: Bar Trash: Queer Horror / Double Feature, SHIVERS (1975) + CREEPOZOIDS (1987), on a special day and time (date not shown in the text read); EMPORIUM PRO WRESTLING PRESENTS: SLASHERAMA, Friday 13 November 2026; Steel of Film (in 35 mm) + Q&A; Colette & Justin + Q&A; National Theatre Live: Golden Boy. Pattern: film screenings with Q&As, 35mm, and a seasonal Bar Trash strand.
